_doc: Central env-flag registry. Owner: core/env_flags.py. Declare every PIPELINE_*/MODEL_* switch (default, purpose, owner) so behaviour is discoverable.

PIPELINE_PROMPT_TIMEOUT.purpose: max seconds to wait for a human prompt

PIPELINE_VERBOSE.purpose: emit verbose per-call/loop logs ([LLM], heartbeats); off = concise

PIPELINE_SECTION_CONTEXT_CHARS.purpose: cap on the assembled upstream context per section call (0 = unlimited)

PIPELINE_CAPABILITY_STEER.purpose: apply the per-agent capability vector to each LLM request (reasoning/min-output); off = unchanged

INSTANCE_TENANT.purpose: tenant a tenant-instance dashboard is bound to (tenant-scoped authz, fail-closed)

PIPELINE_AUTO_ESCALATE.purpose: auto-route a failed gate's retry to the stronger tier (model-tier ladder); off = recommendation only

PIPELINE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.purpose: sectioned agents emit compact JSON per section, rendered deterministically (BI-0224); off = prose

MODEL_GATE_REJECT_UNKNOWN.purpose: fail closed when a capability-critical agent's model fit is UNKNOWN (0 = warn only)

PIPELINE_PREFER_KIND.purpose: prefer a provider kind (direct|aggregator|self-host) when ordering LLM candidates; empty = tier order

PIPELINE_GENERATORS.purpose: enable media generation via generator adapters (BI-0188); off = detection/selection only

PIPELINE_GENERATOR_MAX_SECONDS.purpose: max wait for an async generator job (video/music/3d)

PIPELINE_GENERATOR_POLL_SECONDS.purpose: poll interval for async generator jobs

PIPELINE_FEASIBILITY_STRICT.purpose: treat a build-host 'conditional' feasibility verdict as blocking (0 = advisory)

PIPELINE_FEASIBILITY_GPU_OVERRIDE.purpose: override detected GPU VRAM (GB) for feasibility when nvidia-smi is unavailable
